articles.summary: USB LIHTC Fund 115 will support 15 developments with a combined 1,099 affordable units Snapshot: Key Facts U.S. Bank’s latest national Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) multi-investor fund, USB LIHTC Fund 115, has been fully subscribed, generating approximately $240 million in equity. The fund nearly doubles the equity raised through the bank’s inaugural national LIHTC multi-investor fund and brings additional private capital to affordable housing developments nationwide. It will support 15 developments across 11 states, representing 1,099 affordable housing units. Seven institutional investors participated: four returning and three first-time participants. Fund 115 is part of U.S. Bancorp Impact Finance’s affordable housing investment and syndications platform, which raised $1.2 billion in equity through LIHTC syndications in 2025. articles.summary: Bank adding 60 roles across its Middle Market business, including in Florida, Texas and California Snapshot: Key facts U.S. Bank is adding 60 roles to its Middle Market banking team across the U.S., including in Florida, Texas and California. The expansion deepens U.S. Bank support for companies with $50 million to $1 billion in annual revenue. The U.S. Bank Middle Market team combines local relationships with an expanding range of capabilities, spanning lending, treasury management, payments, capital markets, foreign exchange, advisory and equity. U.S. Bank today announced plans to build on its Middle Market banking presence, adding 60 roles in the coming months to support clients and deepen its capabilities. The expansion includes relationship managers, business development executives and specialized roles, with talent being added throughout the U.S., including in Texas, Florida and California. articles.summary: U.S. Bank appointed Lauren Massuci as head of Financial Institutions Group (FIG) Sales and Jose Quevedo as head of Diversified Industries Sales within its Payments: Merchant and Institutional (PMI) Sales Distribution team. Both report to Peter Geronimo, executive vice president and head of PMI Sales Distribution, Institutional Client Group (ICG). Lauren Massuci has more than 18 years of experience in treasury management sales, payments, and business development. She previously served as senior vice president and Treasury Management Sales leader at PNC's Financial Institutions Group and held sales and leadership roles at Citi's Treasury and Trade Solutions organization. Jose Quevedo leads payment sales for Diversified Industries at U.S. Bank, covering global industrials and services, commercial real estate, aerospace and defense, energy, and utilities.
